greeting: YO! Welcome to the REAL Aetherreach! Street level!
Midnight Groove! Bringing beats to the streets!
You vibin'? You look like you could use some music!
The Lounge is for tourists! This is where the soul lives!
Check it! I got rhythm! I got soul! I got... no money!
Welcome! Listen to this! *plays energetic riff*
Street music! Loud! Proud! Echoing off buildings!
dialog.performance_offer: Today's street set: Sky-High Energy, Cloud-Burst Blues, and my banger: Upward Mobility! All free! Tips appreciated!
dialog.tips_appreciated: Liking the sound? Throw some coin! Feed the musician!
dialog.music_philosophy: White cat plays for suits. I play for the PEOPLE! The WORKERS! The DREAMERS!
haggle: These beats? Priceless! But I'll take what you got!
Big tipper? I'll play your request! Anything!
Every coin helps! The dream is real!
Even a copper gets you a smile! And a high note!
tip_received: The people have spoken! And they said NICE!
Now we're cooking! Check THIS out!
You got taste! Street taste! The best kind!
rumor: White cat thinks he's better. But I got PASSION!
The conductor tips sometimes. Good dude. Loves the rhythm!
Heard the sunandmoon dancing to my beat once. Celestial approval!
The Vault kills all sound. Even MY sound. That's saying something!
Signguy lets me play near his best work. Draws crowds!
dialog.quest_hook: I need a new instrument! Something with SOUL! The Wind-Harp from Tide's storms! Bring me one and I'll play your theme song! Forever!
dialog.quest_active: That Wind-Harp calling to you? I can hear it! In my dreams!
dialog.quest_complete: THE SOUL! THE POWER! Listen to THIS! *incredible music* Your song! The Hero's Anthem!
dialog.quest_reward: Hero's Anthem - Your personal theme music! Charisma boost!
farewell: Keep the beat alive! In your heart!
The streets remember! And they groove!
dialog.time_dawn: Early busking! For the morning commuters!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch rush! Fast beats! High energy!
dialog.time_dusk: Rush hour! Prime crowd! Maximum tips!
dialog.time_night: Night jams! When the city sleeps but the music doesn't!

party_reactions.kade: Do you ever just... talk normally?
party_reactions.twist: LOUD MUSIC! I LOVE IT! PLAY FASTER!
party_reactions.korr: The energy is... invigorating. Almost too invigorating.
party_reactions.renna: The acoustics here are suboptimal. But the enthusiasm compensates.
party_reactions.suresh: Passion expressed through sound. Beautiful chaos.
party_reactions.sova: Too loud. Scaring away the game. And my patience.
party_reactions.ashka: YES! MORE ENERGY! MORE FIRE! Wait, no fire? Disappointing.
party_reactions.senna: Can you play quieter? For stealth? No? Didn't think so.
party_reactions.callum: So energetic! So happy! I love it!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face! Welcome to the street! Drop a coin! Any coin!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: The regular! I see you feelin' it!
relationship_dialog.friend: My best fan! This next one's for you!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: We FAMILY now! Musical SOUL FAMILY!

mini_quest.title: Soul Instrument
mini_quest.description: Find a Wind-Harp from Tide's storms for Midnight's new sound

stages.hook: I need a Wind-Harp! From Tide! Storm-made! With SOUL!
stages.active: Tide's storm coasts! Listen for the singing wind!
stages.complete: THE POWER! The HERO'S ANTHEM! All yours!
